' AND C.SCHM_CODE = A.SCHM_CODE AND C.MEMB_CODE = A.MEMB_CODE ORDER BY C.SCHM_DATE DESC) As LastRecDt FROM AD_MEMB AS A WHERE a.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND DAY(A.JOIN_DATE) >= ' ? dd ? ' GROUP BY A.CO_CODE,A.LC_CODE,A.SCHM_CODE,A.MEMB_CODE,A.MEMB_AMT,A.MEMB_NAME,A.JOIN_DATE,A.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY A.SCHM_CODE,A.MEMB_CODE

' ORDER BY A.SCHM_DATE DESC

Select A.AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.AC_REF_NAME As AC_REFBY,B.AC_CITY,B.AC_KHATA_NO, Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As DrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End As CrAmt, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrGold, Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrGold, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As DrSilver, Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end As CrSilver FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? HM425NEKU ? AND B.AC_GR IN ('20','19') ? HM269NEHP ? VK029NEVK ? HM404NSHM ? AND B.AC_GR = '20' ? AND B.AC_CITY = ' ? ' ? AND B.AC_AREA = ' ? ' ? U ? AND B.AC_GR NOT IN ( ? ) ? GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,B.AC_NAME,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE,B.AC_REF_NAME,B.AC_CITY,B.AC_KHATA_NO ? HAVING (round(Case When SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) < 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End,2)) + ? (round(Case WHEN SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT) > 0 Then abs(SUM(A.CR_AMT-A.DR_AMT)) Else 0 End,2)) + ? (format(Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end,'0.000')) + ? (format(Case When SUM(Case When A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end,'0.000')) + ? (format(Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end,'0.00'))+ ? (format(Case WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) > 0 then abs(SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END)) else 0 end,'0.00')) <> 0 ? ORDER BY B.AC_NAME
